strategies.name: 09:30 BuBC above the pre-open high
strategies.when: Once a day: the 09:30–09:45 New York candle.
steps: Mark the pre-open high: the highest price from 08:00 to 09:30 New York.
The 09:30 15m candle is a BuBC: it closes above the previous 15m candle’s high.
It also closes ABOVE the pre-open high. If it closes inside the pre-open range, no trade.
At the first 15m close below the 09:30 candle’s low. Otherwise out at the 16:59 close.
strategies.why: Buyers broke the whole pre-open range on the opening drive. When that holds, the day tends to keep going up.
strategies.watch: The pre-open filter was picked from 14 filters: expect it a bit weaker live. 1m / 5m CDL entries and limits were tested and are not better.
strategies.tgt: 1:3 RR or a close below the 09:30 low
strategies.plain: Think of 08:00–09:30 as a fence. When the first 15-minute candle of the cash open jumps over the fence and closes above it, buyers broke out of the yard. We buy that close.

strategies.name: Level Retest A · Max Profit
strategies.when: The CDL candle opens 09:30–11:59 New York.
steps: Mark the levels: daily open 18:00, PDH / PDL, overnight high / low (18:00–09:30), Asia high / low (18:00–02:00), 09:30 open, prior 16:00 close, the newest live H1 / H4 GMC.
The 15m MMM structure is up (the last 15m flip was a CDL) on the last closed 15m candle.
A 1m CDL: the 1m structure flips up, and its new PO4 T1 is within 15 pts of a level.
A bullish GMC formed between the PO4 T1 and the CDL with its level inside that range (a gap).
At the CDL close, place a buy limit at the PO4 T1 (fills 1 tick through). Cancel at +80 pts untouched or after 60 candles. A candle closing below the T1 does not cancel it.
1:5 (200 pts). No early exit. Out at the 16:59 close if nothing hits. One trade at a time.
strategies.why: The level is real: the same 1m long with no level near loses in both periods.
strategies.watch: Lead, not proven: only 12 trades in period 2 (real 1-min months). Paper-trade it first.
strategies.plain: The 15m trend is up. On 1m, price flips up right next to a big level. We put a buy order where the flip started (the T1) and let price come back to us.

strategies.name: Level Retest B · Small Loss
strategies.when: The CDL candle opens 09:30–11:59 New York.
steps: Mark the same levels as C.M6.
Same as C.M6: 15m trend up, 1m CDL with its PO4 T1 within 15 pts of a level, no gap.
Buy limit at the PO4 T1, placed at the CDL close. Cancel at +70 pts untouched or after 60 candles.
Max’s 2-candle exit: after a 1m close below the T1 (candle V), get out when a later candle closes below V’s low. A close back above the T1 resets it.
1:5 (175 pts). Out at the 16:59 close if nothing hits. One trade at a time.
strategies.why: Same edge as C.M6 with smaller losses: about 8 in 10 trades close below the T1 at some point, and the 2-candle rule cuts the bad ones early.
strategies.watch: Lead, not proven: WR only 19% and up to 17 losses in a row. Paper-trade it first.
strategies.plain: Same setup as C.M6, with a smaller stop and Max’s 2-candle exit: if price closes under the T1 and then under that candle’s low, we leave early with a small loss.

strategies.name: T3+ Break
strategies.when: Asia 18:00–00:00 and NY AM 09:30–13:30 New York. No new trades 00:00–02:00.
steps: 15 minutes, MMM EDGE PRO, X.M4 on. Read only CLOSED candles.
A 3rd or later break of the same trend: a 15m candle closes past the expander box (LDx2+ for longs, SDx2+ for shorts). The new PO4 is T3 or higher.
Yesterday’s daily candle points your way: green for longs, red for shorts.
Market order at the close of that break candle.
1.5 × ATR(14) of the 15m chart, away from the entry.
Take half off at +0.5R and move the stop to entry. The runner goes to the first opposite break or 1:6.
strategies.why: A trend that beat the other side three times keeps trapping the traders who fade it.
strategies.watch: Numbers = every hour except 00:00–02:00. Asia + NY AM only made every proven setup better in both periods.
strategies.plain: A trend that already beat the other side twice breaks a 3rd time. Late breakers keep trapping the traders who fade them. We join at the close and bank half early.

strategies.name: GMC Long
strategies.when: Asia 18:00–00:00 and NY AM 09:30–13:30 New York. No new trades 00:00–02:00.
steps: 15 minutes, MMM EDGE PRO, C.M3 on.
A bullish GMC: candle 2 closes above candle 1’s high and candle 3’s low stays above candle 1’s high (a gap).
Market order at the close of candle 3.
1 × ATR(14) of the 15m chart below the entry.
Half off at +0.75R, stop to entry. The runner goes to 1:3.
strategies.why: Buyers wanted in so badly that price never came back to candle 1. That urgency tends to carry on.
strategies.watch: The busiest EDGE PRO setup with a small edge per trade. Numbers = every hour except 00:00–02:00. Asia + NY AM only made every proven setup better in both periods.
strategies.plain: A GMC is a 3-candle jump that leaves a gap, like footprints that skip a step. Buyers were in a hurry. We buy the close of candle 3 when yesterday was green.

strategies.name: GMC AFs Long
strategies.when: Asia 18:00–00:00 and NY AM 09:30–13:30 New York. No new trades 00:00–02:00.
steps: 15 minutes, MMM EDGE PRO, C.M4 on.
A bullish GMC where candle 3 makes a new high but closes back INSIDE candle 2 (AFs against the gap).
Yesterday’s daily candle is green AND the 1h box trend is up.
Market order at the close of candle 3.
1 × ATR(14) of the 15m chart below the entry.
Half off at +0.5R, stop to entry. The runner goes to 1:6.
strategies.why: The “rejection” cannot reach the gap, so it only shakes out weak buyers.
strategies.watch: Numbers = every hour except 00:00–02:00. Asia + NY AM only made every proven setup better in both periods.
strategies.plain: Candle 3 pokes a new high, then closes back inside candle 2. Weak buyers got shaken out, but the gap still holds. We buy that close.

strategies.name: BC+ Long
strategies.when: Asia 18:00–00:00 and NY AM 09:30–13:30 New York. No new trades 00:00–02:00.
steps: 15 minutes, MMM EDGE PRO, C.M5 on.
A BC+ bull candle: it closes above the previous high, makes no new low and closes in its upper half.
Yesterday’s daily candle is green AND the 1h box trend is up.
Market order at the close of that candle.
Half off at +0.5R, stop to entry. The runner goes to 1:2.
strategies.why: A clean winning candle inside a trend that is already working.
strategies.watch: Smallest edge per trade of the five. Numbers = every hour except 00:00–02:00. Asia + NY AM only made every proven setup better in both periods.
strategies.plain: A BC+ candle closes above the last high, makes no new low and closes near its top: buyers controlled the whole candle. We buy its close.

strategies.name: Contraction Limit Long
strategies.when: The limit must fill in Asia (18:00–02:00 New York).
steps: 15 minutes, MMM EDGE PRO, X.M5 on (contraction boxes).
A bullish continuation break of a contraction box (LDx).

Buy limit at 75% down the break candle (MP). It fills 1 tick through. Cancel after 20 candles, at the next session open, on the next break, if the target prints first, or on a close below the break candle.
Half off at +0.5R, stop to entry. The runner goes to 1:2.
strategies.why: A tight box stores energy. The first small dip after the break is the traders who missed it.
strategies.watch: Watch only: in 2026 (1-min months) it made just +0.06 avg RR.
strategies.plain: After a break out of a quiet box, price often dips back into the break candle. We wait with a buy limit 75% down the candle, like waiting for a sale.

strategies.name: Zone T3+ Break · Asia + NY AM
strategies.when: Asia 18:00–02:00 or NY AM 09:30–13:30 New York (the signal candle’s close time).
steps: 15 minutes, MMM PRO x, box engine G1 (expander). Also runs inside MMM EDGE PRO.
A 3rd or later break: a 15m close past the box (LDx2+ / SDx2+), new PO4 T3 or higher.
Market order at the close of the break candle.
The whole position: out at the first opposite break (X5 OPP) or at 1:6.
strategies.why: The same signal as X.M4, traded as one full position without the daily filter.
strategies.watch: Half out also works: half off at +0.5R, stop to entry (WR about 68%, avg RR +0.15).
strategies.plain: The 3rd or later break of the same trend, traded only in Asia or the NY morning. One trade, out at the first opposite break or at 1:6.

strategies.name: Contraction T3+ Limit
strategies.when: Asia 18:00–02:00 or NY AM 09:30–13:30 New York (the signal candle’s close time).
steps: 15 minutes, MMM PRO x, contraction boxes. Also runs inside MMM EDGE PRO.
A T3+ continuation break of a contraction box (LDx2+ / SDx2+).
Limit at 75% back into the break candle (MP for longs, MD for shorts), 1 tick through.
strategies.why: Same stored-energy idea as X.M5, both sides.
strategies.watch: Watch only: 2026 (1-min months) made only +0.05 avg RR. Do not use half out here.
strategies.plain: A 3rd or later break out of a quiet box. We wait with a limit 75% back into the break candle and aim for 1:2.

strategies.name: 5m iBlock T4+ Long · Top Limit
steps: 5 minutes, MMM PRO x, iBlocks on.
A bullish iBlock of a T4 or higher PO4 (the 3rd continuation or later).
Buy limit at the TOP of the block (XP) the moment the block is born. No reaction needed.
strategies.why: A late-trend block in a strong move gets defended on the first touch.
strategies.watch: Watch only: the short side lost in every year, and 2026 has only Jul–Oct on 5m.
strategies.plain: When a strong 5m trend leaves a block behind, we put a buy limit at the top of the block the moment it is born. Price often comes back to kiss it.

strategies.name: GMC c3 AFs Against
strategies.when: Asia 18:00–02:00 or NY AM 09:30–13:30 New York (the signal candle’s close time).
steps: 15 minutes, MMM PRO c. Also runs inside MMM EDGE PRO.
A GMC where candle 3 sweeps past candle 2 and closes back inside it (AFs against the gap).
Market order at the close of candle 3, in the GMC direction.
Out at the first confirmed opposite body close (X1) or at 1:6.
strategies.why: A GMC that survives a fake rejection.
strategies.watch: Trade it as one full position: half out killed the edge. Low WR (about 1 in 3), big winners.
strategies.plain: A GMC whose 3rd candle sweeps past candle 2 and closes back inside. The sweep took out stops, the gap still stands. We trade with the gap.

strategies.name: GMC Long · Fixed 50
strategies.when: Asia 18:00–02:00 or NY AM 09:30–13:30 New York (the signal candle’s close time).
steps: 15 minutes, MMM PRO c. Also runs inside MMM EDGE PRO.
Any bullish GMC (candle 2 closes above candle 1, candle 3 keeps the gap).
Market order at the close of candle 3.
Target 1:2. Get out early on a confirmed close below the gap candle’s open (X3-O).
strategies.why: Small edge per trade, many trades.
strategies.watch: Long losing runs (22 in a row). Size small.
strategies.plain: Any bullish GMC: 3 candles that leave a gap. We buy the close of candle 3 with a fixed 50-point stop and aim for 1:2.

strategies.name: Late Continuation Break (P5+)
strategies.when: Any hour in the test. Asia + NY AM only was better (avg RR +0.15 → +0.31).
steps: 15 minutes, MMM EDGE PRO, XCS setups on (engines x, c and s together).
The 5th or later break of the same trend: a candle closes past P5, P6… (LD5+ / SD5+). The new PO4 is T6 or higher.
Market order at the close of the break candle.
Target 1:2. Out at market after 60 candles (15 hours) if nothing hits.
strategies.why: A trend that keeps breaking forward late in the move still has fuel.
strategies.watch: About 1 trade a day. Up to 19 losses in a row.
strategies.plain: The 5th or later break of the same trend. Late in a trend, the breaks still have fuel. Market order at the close, 50-point stop, 1:2.

strategies.name: Any Continuation Break (P1+)
steps: 15 minutes, MMM EDGE PRO, XCS setups on.
A candle closes past any P# of the current trend (LD / SD, first one or later).
Market order at the close of the break candle.
Target 1:2 (1:1 also works). Out after 60 candles.
strategies.why: Many trades, a very small edge on each.
strategies.watch: Trades overlap a lot and the edge is thin: 2026 t-score 1.2.
strategies.plain: Any continuation break of the trend, first or later. The simplest one in the book: close past the box, buy the close.

strategies.name: H4 GMC AFs → 15m CDL Pullback BC
strategies.when: 15m entries in Asia 18:00–02:00 or NY AM 09:30–13:30 New York.
steps: 4 hours for the filter, 15 minutes for the entry.

On 4H, price touches a bull GMC (the gap edge = candle 1 high) and, on that candle or within 3 candles, prints a bullish AFs. No 4H close below the GMC open. The filter lives 6 four-hour candles and dies on a 4H close below the AFs low. Mirror for shorts.
On 15m: a CDL of engine x, c or s, then a bearish BC (the pullback).
Market order at the close of the next 15m BuBC (the first bull body close after the pullback).
strategies.why: A higher-timeframe gap that holds, entered after a small dip on 15m.
strategies.watch: Watch only: small sample (about 60 trades a year), the short side is weak.
strategies.plain: The 4-hour chart gives the green light (a GMC touch with an AFs). Then on 15m we wait for a flip up, one red pullback candle, and buy the next green BC.

strategies.name: H4 GMC AFs → 15m CDL Pullback BC · Long
strategies.when: 15m entries in Asia 18:00–02:00 or NY AM 09:30–13:30 New York.
steps: 4 hours for the filter, 15 minutes for the entry.
On 4H, price touches a bull GMC and prints a bullish AFs within 3 candles. No 4H close below the GMC open. The filter lives 6 four-hour candles.
On 15m: a CDL of engine x, c or s, then a bearish BC (the pullback).
Market order at the close of the next 15m BuBC.
strategies.why: The long side of XCS.M3, the stronger half.
strategies.watch: Watch only: 137 + 28 trades, and both periods were bull markets.
strategies.plain: Same as XCS.M3, long side only.

strategies.name: 15m iBlock Pre-Market AFs+
strategies.when: The touch candle opens 08:00–09:15 New York (pre-market).
steps: 15 minutes, MMM EDGE PRO, XCS setups on, iBlocks on.
The first touch of an iBlock (the origin box of a T2 or higher PO4).
Within 10 candles, an AFs+ in the block direction: it sweeps the previous candle, closes back inside it, in the good half. No close through the PO4 line first.
Market order at the close of the AFs+ candle.
1 tick past the AFs+ candle’s low (long) / high (short).
strategies.why: The only block pattern that held in every year.
strategies.watch: Watch only: about 4 trades a month, and it was found by searching many patterns.
strategies.plain: In the pre-market, price touches a block. A candle sweeps the last low, then closes back in the good half. We enter at that close.

strategies.name: H1 UPG Gap · Box Edge Limit
steps: MMM PRO f on the 5m chart, with the HTF boxes / levels on (H1 or M15 → your chart). Read only CLOSED candles.
Price touches the H1 UPG gap for the first time.
The first MMM PRO f reversal box in your direction prints on 5m: for longs a BuBC that closes above the last bearish candles, with the box low at or inside the level.
No candle closed through the level before the box printed (the level held).
Limit order at the reversal box edge: its top for longs, its bottom for shorts. The first touch fills.
1 tick past the reversal box low (long) / high (short), at least 20 and at most 50 pts.
A candle closes back below the reversal box (long) / above it (short): out at that close.
After the first opposite candle, wait for a BC in profit, then move the stop to that pullback low / high.
At the next session open (18:00 · 02:00 · 08:00 · 09:30 New York): losing → out at the open, winning → trail under each BC. Out at the 2nd session open.
strategies.why: A UPG gap is a hole price left in a hurry. When price comes back to fill it, the side that made the gap usually defends it again.
strategies.watch: Many trades, thin edge (+0.08 RR a trade in 2022–25): it needs low costs and patience. Period 2 for MMM PRO f is about 3 months of 1-minute MNQ (Mar–May and Sep–Oct 2026), so it is a check, not proof.
strategies.plain: Price falls into an H1 gap and turns. The turn leaves a small box on 5m. We wait at the edge of that box with a limit, like a goalkeeper on the line.
strategies.p2note: Period 2 = about 3 months of 1-minute MNQ (Mar–May and Sep–Oct 2026).

The first MMM PRO f reversal box in your direction prints on 5m: for longs a BuBC that closes above the last bearish candles, with the box low at or inside the level.
Only take fills from 12:00 to 16:00 New York.
Limit order at the reversal box edge: its top for longs, its bottom for shorts. The first touch fills.
A candle closes back below the reversal box (long) / above it (short): out at that close.
Once in profit, move the stop under each new BC (over it for shorts).
At the next session open (18:00 · 02:00 · 08:00 · 09:30 New York): losing → out at the open, winning → trail under each BC. Out at the 2nd session open.
strategies.why: A UPG gap is a hole price left in a hurry. When price comes back to fill it, the side that made the gap usually defends it again.
strategies.watch: Every one of its stop and exit settings passed. Period 2 for MMM PRO f is about 3 months of 1-minute MNQ (Mar–May and Sep–Oct 2026), so it is a check, not proof.
strategies.plain: Same box-edge limit, at any UPG gap, only in the NY afternoon.

The first MMM PRO f reversal box in your direction prints on 5m: for longs a BuBC that closes above the last bearish candles, with the box low at or inside the level.

Price touches the MMM PRO f Bu / Be LEZ (M15 · H1 · H4) for the first time.

Limit order at the reversal box edge: its top for longs, its bottom for shorts. The first touch fills.

strategies.name: H1 Box Retest · With The H1 Trend
steps: MMM PRO f on the 5m chart, with the HTF boxes / levels on (H1 or M15 → your chart). Read only CLOSED candles.
Price touches the MMM PRO f H1 box (T#, P#, R#, internal, break box or LEZ) for the first time.
The first MMM PRO f reversal box in your direction prints on 5m: for longs a BuBC that closes above the last bearish candles, with the box low at or inside the level.
No candle closed through the level before the box printed (the level held).
Trade only in the MMM PRO f H1 trend direction.
Price comes back and touches the reversal box, but no candle closes inside it.
A BC closes out of the box: enter at the next open.
1 tick past the reversal box low (long) / high (short), at least 20 and at most 50 pts.
A candle closes back below the reversal box (long) / above it (short): out at that close.
After 1 BC in profit, move the stop to entry.
At the next session open (18:00 · 02:00 · 08:00 · 09:30 New York): losing → out at the open, winning → trail under each BC. Out at the 2nd session open.
strategies.why: The retest proves the box: the other side tried to push back in and failed. The 1st BC back out is the defenders winning again.
strategies.watch: Low WR (16%) with big wins. Only 22 trades in period 2. Period 2 for MMM PRO f is about 3 months of 1-minute MNQ (Mar–May and Sep–Oct 2026), so it is a check, not proof.
strategies.plain: Price comes back to an H1 box, the retest only touches, and a BC closes out. We go with the H1 trend and move to BE after one BC.
strategies.p2note: Period 2 = about 3 months of 1-minute MNQ (Mar–May and Sep–Oct 2026).

strategies.name: LD · Stays Outside 3 Candles
steps: MMM PRO f on the 5m chart. Read only CLOSED candles.
An LD: a 5m candle closes above the last bull box (a continuation break).
Count the next 3 candles. None of them may close back inside the broken box.
Buy at the open of the 4th candle.
1 tick past the reversal box low (long) / high (short), at least 20 and at most 50 pts.
A candle closes back below the broken box: out at that close.
At the next session open (18:00 · 02:00 · 08:00 · 09:30 New York): losing → out at the open, winning → trail under each BC. Out at the 2nd session open.
strategies.why: When no candle closes back inside the broken box, the next break goes the same way about 7 times out of 10, and the move is about twice as big.
strategies.watch: Long only (shorts were weaker). Period 2 for MMM PRO f is about 3 months of 1-minute MNQ (Mar–May and Sep–Oct 2026), so it is a check, not proof.
strategies.plain: An LD is a break up. If the next 3 candles all stay outside the broken box, the break is real: like a door that stays open. We buy the 4th candle.
strategies.p2note: Period 2 = about 3 months of 1-minute MNQ (Mar–May and Sep–Oct 2026).

strategies.name: LD / SD · Stays Outside 3 Candles
steps: MMM PRO f on the 15m chart. Read only CLOSED candles.
An LD (long) or SD (short): a 15m candle closes past the last box in the trend direction.
Count the next 3 candles. None of them may close back inside the broken box.
Enter at the open of the 4th candle.
A candle closes back below the broken box (above it for shorts): out at that close.
After the first opposite candle, wait for a BC in profit, then move the stop to that pullback low / high.
At the next session open (18:00 · 02:00 · 08:00 · 09:30 New York): losing → out at the open, winning → trail under each BC. Out at the 2nd session open.
strategies.why: A break that does not come back inside is a break the other side could not answer. 97% of its stop and exit settings passed both periods.
strategies.watch: Period 2 for MMM PRO f is about 3 months of 1-minute MNQ (Mar–May and Sep–Oct 2026), so it is a check, not proof.
strategies.plain: Same idea on 15m, both sides: the break stays outside for 3 candles, we join it.
strategies.p2note: Period 2 = about 3 months of 1-minute MNQ (Mar–May and Sep–Oct 2026).

strategies.name: 1h LD · Next Open
steps: MMM PRO f on the 1h chart. Read only CLOSED candles.

1 tick past the reversal box low (long) / high (short), at least 20 and at most 50 pts.
A 1h candle closes back below the broken box.
Once in profit, move the stop under each new BC (over it for shorts).
At the next session open (18:00 · 02:00 · 08:00 · 09:30 New York): losing → out at the open, winning → trail under each BC. Out at the 2nd session open.

strategies.name: H1 UPG · 2 BCs, Then Limit At 50%
steps: MMM PRO f on the 5m chart, with the HTF boxes / levels on (H1 or M15 → your chart). Read only CLOSED candles.

The first MMM PRO f reversal box in your direction prints on 5m: for longs a BuBC that closes above the last bearish candles, with the box low at or inside the level. Then a 2nd BC must close in your direction before any retest.
No candle closed through the level before the box printed (the level held).
Price comes back and touches the box.
A BC closes out of the box: place a limit at 50% of that BC. Cancel if price closes back past the box first.

strategies.plain: The box needs 2 BCs to be trusted. Then price retests it, a BC closes out, and we buy the dip at 50% of that BC.

strategies.name: H1 UPG · Max Management (BE + Re-entry)
steps: MMM PRO f on the 5m chart, with the HTF boxes / levels on (H1 or M15 → your chart). Read only CLOSED candles.
Price touches the H1 UPG gap for the first time.

The first MMM PRO f reversal box in your direction prints on 5m: for longs a BuBC that closes above the last bearish candles, with the box low at or inside the level. Then a 2nd BC must close in your direction before any retest.
No candle closed through the level before the box printed (the level held).
Price comes back and touches the box.
A BC closes out of the box: enter at the next open.
1 tick past the reversal box low (long) / high (short), at least 20 and at most 50 pts.
A candle closes back below the reversal box (long) / above it (short): out at that close.

strategies.plain: Max’s own management: after the 1st BC in profit the stop goes to BE + fees. If we get shaken out and the box still holds, we re-enter on the next touch → BC.

No candle closed through the level before the box printed (the level held).
The candle right after the break touches the box.
The 1st BC that closes out of the box: enter at the next open.
1 tick past the reversal box low (long) / high (short), at least 20 and at most 50 pts.

strategies.plain: Fast retests work best on 15m: the candle right after the break already touches the box. Then the 1st BC out is the entry.

strategies.name: M15 UPG · NBC Then Retest, 1 Re-entry
steps: MMM PRO f on the 5m chart, with the HTF boxes / levels on (H1 or M15 → your chart). Read only CLOSED candles.
Price touches the M15 UPG gap for the first time.

The first MMM PRO f reversal box in your direction prints on 5m: for longs a BuBC that closes above the last bearish candles, with the box low at or inside the level. After the break candle, an NBC prints before price comes back to the box.
Price comes back and touches the box.
The 1st BC that closes out of the box: enter at the next open.
Stopped out and the box still holds? Wait for touch → BC out again and re-enter once.
At the next session open (18:00 · 02:00 · 08:00 · 09:30 New York): losing → out at the open, winning → trail under each BC. Out at the 2nd session open.
strategies.why: An NBC after the break means the push paused. That pause is what brings price back for the retest 76–86% of the time.
strategies.watch: Period 2 for MMM PRO f is about 3 months of 1-minute MNQ (Mar–May and Sep–Oct 2026), so it is a check, not proof.
strategies.plain: After the break, a small NBC pauses the push. That pause usually brings price back to the box. Touch, 1st BC out, in. One re-entry allowed.
strategies.p2note: Period 2 = about 3 months of 1-minute MNQ (Mar–May and Sep–Oct 2026).

After 2 BCs in profit, move the stop to entry.
At the next session open (18:00 · 02:00 · 08:00 · 09:30 New York): losing → out at the open, winning → trail under each BC. Out at the 2nd session open.

strategies.watch: WR is only 14% because most trades end at BE. Only 22 trades in period 2. Period 2 for MMM PRO f is about 3 months of 1-minute MNQ (Mar–May and Sep–Oct 2026), so it is a check, not proof.
strategies.plain: On 1m, price goes back and forth before the retest. After the entry, the stop goes to BE after 2 BCs, so full losses are rare.

rejected.title: Don’t trade the flip (CDS / CDL) break candle
rejected.why: A flip is often fake.

rejected.title: Don’t enter on an H1 / H4 AFs at a GMC, GMP or PO4 level (setup 1)
rejected.why: The level reaction alone has no edge.

rejected.title: Don’t trade the GMC pullback system
rejected.why: 0 of 43,880 combos were strong in both periods.

rejected.title: Don’t trade eBlock, iBlock or balanced block touches as a system
rejected.why: Limits at the blocks lose in both periods.

rejected.title: Don’t pick blocks by hold %, volume, delta or POC
rejected.why: Hold % moves with WHEN and HOW price touches (07:00–10:00 NY breaks boxes, deep and high-volume touches break boxes) and random boxes move the same way.

rejected.title: Don’t trade 1H GMC
rejected.why: Don’t trade 1H GMC because its edge faded to about zero in 10 fresh months while volatility doubled (daily ATR 274 → 481 pts).

rejected.title: Don’t trade 1m, 2m or 5m breaks
rejected.why: Costs eat the edge: 1 pt is 0.2R on a 5 pt stop.

rejected.title: Don’t fade MMPD extremes
rejected.why: Extremes mean momentum, not exhaustion, on 15m NQ.

rejected.title: Don’t use the removed gates
rejected.why: t-score below 2 in at least one period.

rejected.title: Don’t chase 60% WR with a fixed 1:2 target
rejected.why: Without ½ out, WR stays near the break-even math.

rejected.title: Don’t trade SWP+ (strong sweeps)
rejected.why: The long edge failed the fresh test.

rejected.title: Don’t hold the 15m CONTRACTION X4 runner to 1:7
rejected.why: It turned negative in 2026.

rejected.title: Don’t trade 1h zone G0 T1 FLIPs or 1h CONTRACTION close
rejected.why: Negative in 2026.

rejected.title: Don’t trade 1h GMC c3 BC+
rejected.why: Faded to zero in 2026.

rejected.title: Don’t use an LTF stop for an HTF idea (magnifier)
rejected.why: Targets get hit often, but WR collapses.

rejected.title: Don’t wait for an LTF flip after an HTF touch
rejected.why: In 61–68% of signals the HTF target is hit before the LTF flip prints.

rejected.title: Don’t buy eBlock touches after a swing flip
rejected.why: Flips are often fake.

rejected.title: Don’t use Premium / Discount to filter break trades
rejected.why: Breaks need momentum, which lives in premium for longs.

rejected.title: Don’t use deep limits or tight structure stops
rejected.why: A deep fill often means the break already failed.

rejected.title: Don’t expect an exit to fix an entry
rejected.why: No close-based exit beat stop + target on avg RR.

rejected.title: Don’t trade the NQ setups on ES
rejected.why: The edge is NQ-only.

rejected.title: Don’t trade Gamma walls, HA pockets or the opening-break lab
rejected.why: None reached t ≥ 2 in both periods.

rejected.title: Don’t skip trades because liquidity sits inside the stop
rejected.why: Price often runs to the liquidity, but after the take it turns back about as often as it keeps going.

rejected.title: Don’t move the stop past the liquidity
rejected.why: A wider stop means fewer contracts and the same win rate.

rejected.title: Don’t trade liquidity sweeps or breaks (4H, day, swings, equal and unfinished highs / lows)
rejected.why: About the same as a random entry.

rejected.title: Don’t sell into a liquidity cluster (or buy into a low one)
rejected.why: The stops get taken, but price keeps going as often as it turns.

rejected.title: Level Retest: don’t enter the gap trades at the CDS / CDL close
rejected.why: The gap trades stay weak even at the CDL close (PF 1.15).

rejected.title: Level Retest: don’t exit at the first close back past the PO4 T1
rejected.why: The losses get smaller (−$13 instead of −$79), but about 80% of the trades that later win also close back past the T1 first.

rejected.title: Don’t trade the London 02:00–05:00 or the 1H 09:00 opening candles
rejected.why: The first touch of a candle high / low is a coin flip: about 50% reverse, 50% close through, at every candle.

rejected.title: Touch + reaction vs close through at a level: no edge either way
rejected.why: It is a coin flip: about 50% reverse and 50% close through, at every level and every candle.

rejected.title: Level Retest outside NY AM, on shorts, or at the NY AM / PM / settlement levels
rejected.why: Only NY AM longs work.

rejected.title: Don’t buy the 2nd break after the pullback closed back inside the box
rejected.why: After a close back inside, 54–56% go on to the 2nd break and 41–43% close below the box low first: close to a coin flip.

rejected.title: Don’t short the failed GMC (c3 BuBC → NBCs → close below the block, then below the GMC)
rejected.why: After the entry, about 1.5 BCs follow the trade before an opposite BC, the same as a random entry.

rejected.title: Don’t trade a close past the last GMC + the last NBC or expander block
rejected.why: It acts like entering on a random candle: same WR, same small loss after costs.

rejected.title: Don’t buy the retest of a block after a long range
rejected.why: Price does come back to the edge within 20 candles about 85% of the time, but just as often for a 2–5 candle block as for a 21+ candle one.

rejected.title: Don’t trade the flip (first opposite BC) or its confirmation BC on 5m–4H
rejected.why: After a flip, about 1.5 more BCs follow its way before the old side comes back: a coin flip.

rejected.title: Don’t trade a plain 1H or 4H body close (BuBC / BeBC / AFs) on its own
rejected.why: No hour and no candle type held in both periods.

rejected.title: Don’t trade London (02:00–08:00) or pre-market (08:00–09:30) New York
rejected.why: Almost every strategy lost there in both periods.

rejected.title: Don’t move the EDGE PRO entry past a liquidity cluster
rejected.why: The limit fills only when the signal is wrong (price runs through the cluster).

rejected.title: PRO f: retest + 2nd BC on 1m at any level
rejected.why: Loses −0.05 to −0.10 RR a trade. The edge only shows at specific levels and on 5m / 15m.

rejected.title: PRO f: the break candle as the entry
rejected.why: Negative almost everywhere.

rejected.title: PRO f: 2 more BCs right after the break, then wait for a retest
rejected.why: Price comes back only 25–57% of the time, and the trades that do come are weak.

rejected.title: PRO f: lots of back and forth before the touch
rejected.why: Break → NBC → opposite BC → touch was the worst pre-touch pattern.

filters.why: The only Delta rules with t ≥ 3 in both periods.

filters.title: Max 2 open trades
filters.why: Stacked trades lose together on the same move.

filters.title: Yesterday’s daily candle in the trade direction
filters.why: The HTF buyers are already in control.

filters.title: 1h box trend up (C.M4 and C.M5)
filters.why: Removes most choppy days for C.M4 and C.M5.

filters.title: 2+ setups on the same 15m candle
filters.why: More than one reading of control agrees.

filters.title: Volatility stops (ATR) instead of fixed points in fast markets
filters.why: Daily ATR went from 274 to about 481–496 pts in 2026.

filters.title: Live box control: where the last close sits in the box
filters.why: Closing location shows who is winning the tug-of-war.

filters.title: Skip CPI, NFP and FOMC days
filters.why: News spikes make gaps from one big order, not real buying.

filters.title: Liquidity close to price gets taken (use as a guide, not a signal)
filters.why: Distance decides, not the type.

filters.title: Liquidity clusters: expect the wick, don’t trade it
filters.why: Price goes back for them about 8 of 10 times when they are close, the same as one swing at that distance.

filters.title: Level Retest: skip it when a GMC gap sits between the PO4 T1 and the CDL
filters.why: With a gap the retest does not work (PF 1.00).

filters.title: EDGE PRO daily stop: no new trade after 2 losing trades in a day
filters.why: Bad days keep going bad: after the first losses of the day, the next trades are weaker.

filters.title: PRO f: no close back inside the broken box for 3 candles
filters.why: The next break goes the same way about 7 times out of 10, and the move is about 2× bigger.

filters.title: PRO f: a wick-only retest (no close inside the box)
filters.why: Better than a retest that closes inside, on 5m and 15m, in both periods.

filters.title: PRO f: a box with an NBC inside
filters.why: It gets retested 71–83% of the time (BC on BC boxes only 49–67%).

filters.title: PRO f: UPG gaps as the HTF level
filters.why: The best HTF level in every round of the PRO f tests.
